edges.reason: Owned constructor sets owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged account.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete the handover.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner.
owner state variable is written from msg.sender in the constructor.
transferOwnership writes the staged newOwner parameter.
acceptOwnership overwrites the privileged owner variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner after promotion.
onlyOwner guards execution of transferOwnership.
The token constructor is restricted by onlyOwner, relying on owner being set in Owned's constructor.
onlyOwner guards the arbitrary-token rescue function.
msg.sender is embedded in the PoW digest and receives the minted reward.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns decimals.
Constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply.
Constructor flips the locked deployment guard to true.
Constructor zeroes tokensMinted.
Constructor zeroes rewardEra.
Constructor initializes maxSupplyForEra to half of total supply.
Constructor initializes miningTarget to _MAXIMUM_TARGET.
latestDifficultyPeriodStarted is seeded from block.number at deployment.
Constructor immediately starts the first mining epoch.
challengeNumber depends on block.blockhash(block.number - 1), a miner-influenced block input.
_startNewMiningEpoch writes the new challengeNumber.
_startNewMiningEpoch may increment rewardEra.
_startNewMiningEpoch recomputes maxSupplyForEra.
_startNewMiningEpoch increments epochCount.
Every _BLOCKS_PER_READJUSTMENT epochs difficulty is readjusted.
Era threshold computation uses the exponent 2**(rewardEra + 1).
Exponent-based division result is stored into maxSupplyForEra.
Difficulty timing is derived from block.number deltas, which miners can influence.
Difficulty readjust performs chained mul/div/sub/add on miningTarget and block deltas.
Arithmetic block writes the new miningTarget value.
latestDifficultyPeriodStarted is refreshed from block.number.
limitLessThan clamps the difficulty percentage deltas.
mint performs the PoW-verified reward accounting block.
Reward is credited to balances[msg.sender] inside the accounting block.
balances is increased for the successful miner.
tokensMinted is accumulated before the era assertion.
mint reads challengeNumber for the PoW digest and replay mapping.
mint reads and writes solutionForChallenge to prevent double rewards.
Successful mint rotates to a new mining epoch.
lastRewardTo diagnostic is set to msg.sender.
lastRewardAmount diagnostic stores the reward.
lastRewardEthBlockNumber is derived from block.number.
Block-number input flows into the diagnostic reward block field.
mint queries getMiningReward for the reward amount.
Epoch rotation compares the next reward against maxSupplyForEra.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
transfer updates sender and recipient balances.
Sender balance subtraction is routed through SafeMath.sub.
Recipient balance addition is routed through SafeMath.add.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve updates the allowance mapping.
transferFrom consumes the allowance of msg.sender.
transferFrom updates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
allowance getter reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to the requested tokens.
approveAndCall writes the allowance mapping before calling out.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the spender contract.
The spender-controlled receiveApproval callback re-enters the token without a reentrancy guard.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
Malicious tokenAddress contract can re-enter via its transfer implementation.
Rescued tokens are routed to the owner address.
totalSupply reads the fixed _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
getMiningDifficulty divides by _MAXIMUM_TARGET.
getMiningDifficulty reads the current miningTarget.
getChallengeNumber returns challengeNumber.
getMiningTarget returns miningTarget.
Reward is divided by 2**rewardEra, tying it to the era state.
Reward scaling depends on the decimals state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: mint nonce is only meaningful inside the mint PoW verification.
challenge_digest is compared inside mint to accept the mined solution.
transfer destination is consumed only by the transfer function.
transfer amount is consumed only by the transfer function.
approve spender is only used to key the allowance mapping.
approve amount is only used to set the allowance value.
transferFrom source address is only used in that function.
transferFrom destination address is only used in that function.
transferFrom amount is only used in that function.
allowance query owner is a read-only helper argument.
allowance query spender is a read-only helper argument.
approveAndCall spender is the callback target contract.
approveAndCall amount sets the pre-callback allowance.
approveAndCall data blob is forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary token address drives the external call in transferAnyERC20Token.
Rescue amount is passed to the external token transfer.
balanceOf account is a read-only lookup argument.
Staged owner address is written by transferOwnership.
Nonce is hashed in the checkMintSolution view helper.
Caller-supplied target is used for the helper's comparison only.
Nonce is hashed in the getMintDigest debug helper.
Local digest is the PoW verification value inside mint.
Local solution copy implements the per-challenge replay guard in mint.
Local reward amount is the value credited by the mint accounting block.
Block delta local drives the difficulty division and branch selection.
Clamped excess percentage local scales the hardening step.
Clamped shortage percentage local scales the easing step.
Local digest is recomputed for the helper's equality check.
Local digest is the value returned by the debug helper.
